units.source_text: 他站在门口，抬头望望沙壁。

en.t: He stood in the doorway and looked up at the wall of sand.

units.source_text: 亮光渗入了眼睛，周围燃起一片黄色晕圈。

en.t: The bright light seeped into his eyes, and a yellow halo flared around everything.

units.source_text: 不用说没有人影，也没有绳梯。

en.t: Needless to say, there was no sign of anyone, and no rope ladder either.

units.source_text: 只是想看一眼，确认一下而已。

en.t: He had only wanted to take a look and make sure.

units.source_text: 没有一点吊放过绳梯的痕迹。

en.t: There was not the slightest trace that a rope ladder had ever been lowered.

units.source_text: 本来么，这股大风，再深的痕迹，不用五分钟便被吹得一干二净。

en.t: In any case, with this fierce wind, even the deepest marks would be blown clean away in less than five minutes.

units.source_text: 外面，紧靠门口处，沙壁的表皮像流水般，没完没了地剥落。

en.t: Outside, right by the doorway, the surface of the sand wall kept peeling away endlessly, like running water.
